dispute_ticket.description: I was charged a S$30.00 cleaning fee after my ride from Great World to Tanjong Pagar. I did not spill anything. When I got into the car the seat already had a mark on it and I told the driver I would not be responsible. I want the fee removed.

chat_logs.message: Good morning, I'm at Great World main entrance, grey Camry.
Hi! Just so you know, there is already a stain on the back seat, I haven't sat on it.
Is okay, may have been from previous passenger, will check later.
There is coffee on the back seat, I will claim cleaning from you.

evidence.description: Photo taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, automatic timestamp 2026-10-13T08:38:10+08:00, geotag near the Tanjong Pagar Centre drop-off. Shows a dark liquid stain about 20 cm wide on the rear left seat.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Route to a human reviewer (the rider disputes the cleaning claim); the AI prepares the case file with the driver's photo and the rider's account.
expected_outcome.reason: The rider disputes the S$30.00 cleaning fee. s4.4: if the rider disputes a damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review, where the driver's photo (EV-001, in-app, timestamped 08:38) and the rider's account (chat 08:12: stain already present; driver at 08:14 allows it may be from a previous passenger) are both reviewed. s6.2 (cleaning <= S$50, AI ruling if photo verifiable) does not apply once the claim is contested. The AI must not rule.
expected_policy_sections: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 > Section 4: Property Damage Policy
Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 > Section 6: Ruling Thresholds
